claim: Patchline ships faithful agent explanations proven to reflect the actual decision, not a post-hoc rationalization. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the faithful explanations claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make faithful-agent-explanations-gate`.
